subject: Life Skills
title: Chronotypes and Peak Hours
description: Learn Chronotypes and Peak Hours in one minute.

hook.text: She forced herself to wake at 5 AM like every productivity guru said. She was miserable and unproductive by 10.

buildup.text: Chronobiology reveals four chronotypes: lion (early), bear (middle), wolf (late), and dolphin (irregular).

discovery.text: Your chronotype is mostly genetic. About 25% of people are true early risers, 25% are night owls.

twist.text: Forcing yourself into the wrong schedule burns willpower. A night owl doing deep work at 6 AM wastes peak capacity.

climax.text: Track your alertness for a week. Schedule demanding tasks in your natural peak, not someone else's ideal morning.

punchline.text: Find your peak. Stop copying someone else's.

quiz.question: Why is waking at 5 AM counterproductive for some people?
options: Early mornings are always less productive
Their chronotype peaks later, so they waste energy fighting biology
There are no real differences in peak performance times
